description: A bed with a dark blue blanket and a pale pink pillow is in front, with two small white drawer-like box pieces on the blanket. The left hand reaches forward to steady the upper box piece while the right hand grasps the lower piece by its knob and slides it inward, aligning it under the top piece; both hands briefly hold the stacked unit as it comes together, then the right hand eases off while the left hand remains near it.
